Subject: Audio Recording of Earnings Call on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and 
Consolidated) of Steamhouse India Limited (the “Company”) for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform the Exchanges that the audio recording of the Earnings Call 
held by Steamhouse India Limited on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 1:00 P.M. IST, in relation to the Unaudited 
Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 
30, 2026, is available on the website of the Company. 
 
The audio recording of the Earnings Call can be accessed through the following link: 
https://steamhouse.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/10048158.mp3 
 
The above information is also available on the website of the Company at www.steamhouse.in. 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking You, 
For Steamhouse India Limited
